evidence.observation: The exhaust O2 sensor is not installed, and the growth stage requires it, so the tube atmosphere can't be checked.
Temperature tracked the ramp setpoint closely. It overshot to 760 °C when growth started, then settled at 750 °C.
Pressure stayed steady at about 759 Torr (atmospheric) the whole run. At this pressure a seal leak wouldn't show up on the gauge.
Argon flow matched the setpoint: 200 sccm during purge, 100 sccm during ramp and growth.
Heater power rose smoothly during the ramp and held steady at about 44% during growth.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or another independent check of the atmosphere such as a leak check or a portable O2 meter at the exhaust, to confirm the tube is free of oxygen during growth. The sample also needs characterization after the run.
